text:
anya: FYI - eu-central NVMe p99 read jumped ~450ms and several GPU attaches timed out. noticed a flurry of metadata-verify jobs kicked off by storage-verify.

sre-bot: ALERT: pool=eu-central-local read_p99=452ms over 5m; gpu-attach fail rate rising.

ryan: digging in logs: storage-verify started a full metadata-verify across scratchvols after a delayed checksum window. it walks inodes with many small reads, looks like it collided with normal attach flow.

cho: can we pause verify and throttle existing workers? quickest is to stop the verify controller and apply io caps to the verify process.

anya: I stopped the verify rollout in storage-ops and signalled running workers to finish current file then sleep. also applied per-node cgroup v2 io.max caps: rbps=30M r_iops=300.

sre-bot: ACTION: storage-ops rollout paused (by anya). in-flight verifier processes rate-limited on affected nodes. routing policy temporarily prefers us-west2 for new attaches (20m).

ryan: after caps p99 back to ~30ms on sampled nodes, attach backlog draining. follow-ups: 1) add preflight to storage-verify to check cluster IO headroom; 2) stagger verifies per-az; 3) add early SMART and iowait alerts tied to verifier start.

cho: filing INFRA-8450: "metadata-verify vs attach collision -> IO caps, preflight, staggered rollout" and including rollback play (pause rollout + cgroup cap + regional flip).

anya: thanks team - monitoring eu-central for 30m :white_check_mark:
